cues.en: Hi, and welcome to this AI and C-Sharp video about MCP apps.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎觀看這支介紹 MCP Apps 的 C# AI 教學影片。

cues.en: So we know MCP by being a remote MCP server that can have tools and resources.
cues.zh: 我們已經知道，遠端 MCP 伺服器可以提供工具與資源。

cues.en: If you haven't looked at resources, you might want to see my previous videos about that.
cues.zh: 如果還沒有看過資源的介紹，可以先參考前面的影片。

cues.en: But essentially it is, let's give some input into the form of text and let's receive back some data, often JSON or just some values,
cues.zh: 基本上，MCP 是以文字形式提供輸入，再取得資料回應，通常是 JSON 或一些數值，

cues.en: and then let the AI interpret and visualize that data.
cues.zh: 接著讓 AI 解讀並呈現這些資料。

cues.en: But MCP can also do what is called apps, meaning some visuals.
cues.zh: 不過 MCP 也能提供所謂的 Apps，也就是視覺化介面。

cues.en: In the past, there was something called MCPUI, and MCP apps have sort of taken over that, so MCPUI is not really a thing anymore.
cues.zh: 以前有一套稱為 MCPUI 的機制，現在大致已由 MCP Apps 取代，因此 MCPUI 已經不是主要方向。

cues.en: This is a better approach.
cues.zh: 這是更好的做法。

cues.en: And in order to show you this, I want to show you a piece of code that I wrote here, or disclaimer.
cues.zh: 為了示範，我想先展示這份程式碼。不過先說明一下，

cues.en: An AI agent has mostly written this code because lots of it is about JavaScript and HTML, and I'm not very good at that.
cues.zh: 大部分程式碼是由 AI 代理程式撰寫，因為其中很多是 JavaScript 與 HTML，而我並不擅長這些。

cues.en: So it's got to write those parts, and I had the C-sharp parts.
cues.zh: 因此那些部分交給 AI，我自己處理 C# 部分。

cues.en: But I'm in no way an expert in JavaScript, so that's the main reason for that.
cues.zh: 我不是 JavaScript 專家，這就是主要原因。

cues.en: But I have a small sample, like always, which is an MCP server, and it has a few tools and some resources.
cues.zh: 和往常一樣，我準備了一個小範例，是一個包含幾個工具與資源的 MCP 伺服器。

cues.en: They have some extra things, but we will first see the live result of this because that MCP app I've called MyMCPApp, and it's just running localhost here.
cues.zh: 它們多了一些額外設定，不過先看實際執行結果。我把這個 MCP App 命名為 MyMCPApp，目前在 localhost 執行。

cues.en: And if I go and talk with that, and I ask, for example,
cues.zh: 如果和它對話，例如要求：

cues.en: use MyMCPApp to find out what 242 plus 300 is.
cues.zh: 使用 MyMCPApp 算出 242 加 300 是多少。

cues.en: Only show app, not extra text.
cues.zh: 只顯示 App，不要額外文字。

cues.en: And if this has been a normal MCP, I could, of course, have had a calculate tool, and I actually have that.
cues.zh: 如果只是一般 MCP，當然也可以提供計算工具，而我確實有建立。

cues.en: If we see it over here, I have a small calculate tool here that takes in a first number, an operation, and a second number, and call it back.
cues.zh: 可以看到這個小型 Calculate 工具，接收第一個數字、運算子，以及第二個數字，再回傳結果。

cues.en: It happens in a slightly special way over here, which is called a call tool result, where it can both give some context
cues.zh: 這裡採用稍微特別的方式，回傳 CallToolResult，可以同時提供上下文內容，

cues.en: and some structured content.
cues.zh: 以及結構化內容。

cues.en: But let's see what happens when we run this because in a normal way, it would just call the tool, and then the AI would come back and say, these two numbers equals this.
cues.zh: 不過先看看執行結果。一般情況下，AI 只會呼叫工具，再告訴你這兩個數字相加的結果。

cues.en: But with apps, we can do something more cool.
cues.zh: 使用 Apps，則可以做到更有趣的事情。

cues.en: So it is now figuring out what's going on, calling my tool, and displaying some visual thing.
cues.zh: 它現在正在判斷該怎麼做，呼叫工具，再顯示視覺化介面。

cues.en: There we go.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: So now it's finished, and this is actually a calculator, and it works.
cues.zh: 現在已經完成，這其實是一個能正常運作的計算機。

cues.en: So we can, for example, go and say 4 plus 5 equals 9.
cues.zh: 例如可以輸入 4 加 5，結果等於 9。

cues.en: And what happens down here is every single time we do a calculation, it will always get this context. So we can say,
cues.zh: 每次進行計算時，下面都會把這些上下文傳回去。因此可以接著問，

cues.en: what was the last result?
cues.zh: 上一個結果是多少？

cues.en: And it would know that I pressed 4 plus 5 equals 9 because it got this context object.
cues.zh: 它就會知道剛剛按的是 4 加 5 等於 9，因為取得了這個 Context 物件。

cues.en: So how does this work, and how can you implement it?
cues.zh: 那麼，這是如何運作，又該如何實作呢？

cues.en: Well, if we have a look, we ask an AI agent something.
cues.zh: 首先，我們向 AI 代理程式提出問題。

cues.en: In our case, it's a 2 plus 2, and it determines that that is a good prompt in order to send to this specific MCP.
cues.zh: 這個例子是 2 加 2，AI 會判斷這個提示詞適合交給特定的 MCP。

cues.en: So that's nothing special in that.
cues.zh: 這部分沒有什麼特別之處。

cues.en: It's just have the normal tool discovery, and it works.
cues.zh: 就是一般的工具探索機制。

cues.en: So it sends the request, and essentially just send it over to a tool call, and the tool call has an open calculator.
cues.zh: 它送出請求，轉成工具呼叫，這裡呼叫的是 OpenCalculator。

cues.en: And that calculator is just an MCP tool, but at the same time, it also has some metadata around that tool
cues.zh: 這個計算機本身只是 MCP 工具，但工具同時附帶一些中繼資料，

cues.en: that says this tool is good by showing a UI.
cues.zh: 表示這項工具適合透過 UI 呈現。

cues.en: So it essentially comes back and asks for some UI, and that is where the MCP resources comes in,
cues.zh: 因此用戶端會進一步要求 UI，這就是 MCP 資源派上用場的地方。

cues.en: where it goes in and say, hey, whenever you use me, use this UI resource, which is essentially just some HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
cues.zh: 工具會表示：使用我時，請採用這個 UI 資源。內容基本上就是 HTML、CSS 與 JavaScript。

cues.en: Once that comes back, it's the tool result, and now that it knows that there are UI involved, in my case, codecs,
cues.zh: 回傳工具結果後，用戶端知道其中涉及 UI。在我的範例中，Codex

cues.en: will know to actually show that UI.
cues.zh: 就會知道要顯示這個介面。

cues.en: That happens in a sandbox iframe, so it's essentially just saying, hey, let me make an iframe directly in the chat
cues.zh: 介面會放在沙箱 iframe 中，也就是直接在對話裡建立一個 iframe，

cues.en: and show the result of that HTML that comes back.
cues.zh: 顯示回傳 HTML 所呈現的內容。

cues.en: And that HTML can actually also, using JavaScript, talk back to the server.
cues.zh: 這份 HTML 也可以透過 JavaScript 與伺服器溝通。

cues.en: It could, of course, use normal JavaScript to just make a calculator, but in my case, I have set it to actually do the calculation server-side,
cues.zh: 當然，可以單純用 JavaScript 在本機計算，但這個範例特別設定為由伺服器端執行運算，

cues.en: so it needs to call back and forward between the sandbox UI and use some of the other tools.
cues.zh: 因此沙箱 UI 需要來回呼叫伺服器，使用其他工具。

cues.en: In our case, it's just a calculator, but imagine that you can show any kind of data.
cues.zh: 這裡只是計算機，但你可以想像成任何形式的資料呈現。

cues.en: It could be a customer, and you could show the customer's record in a visual style,
cues.zh: 例如顯示客戶，以視覺化方式呈現客戶紀錄，

cues.en: and you can even have that you could buy something using that UI and then have a tool called add order, for example,
cues.zh: 甚至可以透過這個 UI 購買商品，接著呼叫 AddOrder 這類工具，

cues.en: or switch address or whatever you need to do.
cues.zh: 或是修改地址，執行任何需要的操作。

cues.en: It's just UI and tools, so essentially a frontend and a backend, but it's all happening within a sandbox framework on the MCP.
cues.zh: 本質上就是 UI 與工具，也就是前端與後端，只是全部在 MCP 的沙箱架構裡運作。

cues.en: This thing cannot go out and work with your chat client.
cues.zh: 這個介面無法任意操作對話用戶端。

cues.en: It can send the context, as we saw, but it cannot touch anything outside.
cues.zh: 如前面所見，它可以傳送上下文，但不能存取外部其他內容。

cues.en: The way it works is, as I mentioned, we have a tool, and that tool sends some extra metadata
cues.zh: 具體做法是，讓工具回傳額外的中繼資料，

cues.en: about that the UI it should be used to render this tool is in this specific resource UI,
cues.zh: 指出用來呈現這個工具的 UI，位於這個特定的 UI 資源。

cues.en: and there's two different ways of writing that so all different clients can understand this.
cues.zh: 這裡使用兩種不同寫法，方便不同用戶端理解。

cues.en: So Codex, Cloud Code, GitHub Copilot understand this.
cues.zh: 因此 Codex、Claude Code 與 GitHub Copilot 都能理解。

cues.en: There's a few of the AI coding that doesn't support it yet, but that's just a matter of time.
cues.zh: 還有少數 AI 程式開發工具尚未支援，但只是時間問題。

cues.en: Essentially, we just say open calculator.
cues.zh: 這裡基本上就是宣告 OpenCalculator。

cues.en: We get some input, perhaps.
cues.zh: 它可能會接收一些輸入。

cues.en: We could also just set open calculator and not just giving it a calculation immediately, and it does calculate, which is just another tool
cues.zh: 也可以只要求開啟計算機，不必立刻提供算式。另外還有 Calculate 工具，

cues.en: that also can, if called, tell, hey, I want to be visualized using this resource.
cues.zh: 被呼叫時也可以宣告，希望透過這個資源呈現結果。

cues.en: The tool itself is just taking in the numbers and using a little C-sharp to figure out what is the number and then give it back as built context,
cues.zh: 工具本身只是接收數字，以少量 C# 程式碼計算，再回傳兩種形式的上下文，

cues.en: so raw text and a JSON visualized version of the same data as well.
cues.zh: 包含原始文字，以及同一份資料的 JSON 結構化版本。

cues.en: But then we have the resource, so that resource is down here, so we can see this name here.
cues.zh: 接著是資源，定義在下面，可以看到這個名稱。

cues.en: It's the same as what we have up in these metadata, and this one simply just go in and say, hey,
cues.zh: 它和上面中繼資料中的名稱一致。這個資源只要表示，

cues.en: whenever we do this, serve this HTML, and that HTML is over here, which is a calculator HTML.
cues.zh: 每次使用它時，提供這份 HTML，而這份 HTML 就是旁邊的 Calculator.html。

cues.en: In our case, it's pure HTML CSS JavaScript, but it could have been React, for example, as well, if you want to have more advanced things,
cues.zh: 這個例子使用純 HTML、CSS 與 JavaScript。如果需要更進階的功能，也可以用 React 等框架。

cues.en: and this is where I'm not that strong, but we can see it's just an HTML document with a normal header and stuff.
cues.zh: 這部分不是我的強項，不過可以看到，它就是一份一般 HTML 文件，有標準標頭等內容。

cues.en: There's some styling here, and one of the things is it can actually do theming, so if my codex runs in dark mode, it can show it in dark mode.
cues.zh: 這裡有一些樣式設定，其中一項是支援佈景主題。因此當 Codex 使用深色模式時，介面也能顯示深色模式。

cues.en: If it's in light mode, it can show it in light mode, so it understands that things, but else it's just CSS that it added.
cues.zh: 如果是淺色模式，也會跟著切換。除此之外，其餘就只是一般 CSS。

cues.en: Then it goes in and builds the calculator, so we saw it over here, so that's just a bunch of buttons
cues.zh: 接著建立剛剛看到的計算機，基本上就是一組按鈕，

cues.en: with various 0 to 9 and plus and minus and so on, and then we begin to have a display
cues.zh: 包括零到九、加減號等等，再加上顯示區域，

cues.en: of what the values are in the different areas.
cues.zh: 顯示各個部分的目前數值。

cues.en: Then it can send messages back and forward to its parent, meaning the MCP host.
cues.zh: 接著可以和父層互傳訊息，也就是 MCP Host。

cues.en: So we can request the data.
cues.zh: 因此可以提出資料請求。

cues.en: It can show results, and we can see here that when it tries and requests,
cues.zh: 也能顯示結果。這裡可以看到，當它提出請求時，

cues.en: it sends it to the calculator down here, so that's down in the calculate. Here we are.
cues.zh: 會交給下面的計算函式，也就是這裡的 Calculate。

cues.en: So it requests that it needs to call a specific tool.
cues.zh: 它會要求呼叫指定的工具。

cues.en: It needs to be the tool calculate, which we add over here.
cues.zh: 工具必須是這裡加入的 Calculate。

cues.en: That's what it's hitting here, and it needs to send the arguments of the first number, the operation, and the second number,
cues.zh: 呼叫時會來到這裡，並傳送第一個數字、運算子與第二個數字等參數。

cues.en: and this calculate down here is added to this listener where it can go in and whenever we press the buttons,
cues.zh: 下面的 Calculate 也會接到事件監聽器上，因此當我們按下按鈕時，

cues.en: we begin to have some back-end fields to be able to know what was the first number, what was the second number, what was the operation,
cues.zh: 會以一些內部欄位記錄第一個數字、第二個數字，以及運算子。

cues.en: and at one point it will begin to do a calculate either when we press the equal sign or if it knows that we now have two numbers and go in and do the calculation.
cues.zh: 按下等號，或是程式知道已經取得兩個數字、可以計算時，就會執行計算。

cues.en: There's things for applying theme and various things of sending these messages back and forward.
cues.zh: 另外也有套用佈景主題，以及來回傳送訊息的各種處理。

cues.en: Again, this is all wipe-coded.
cues.zh: 再次強調，這些都是以 Vibe Coding 的方式完成。

cues.en: I honestly don't have any idea exactly how this works, but that's just a spec, and it would be silly of me to sit and waste hours
cues.zh: 老實說，我沒有完全掌握每一個實作細節。不過這就是一份規格，當 AI 代理程式可以非常容易地完成時，

cues.en: when an AI agent can do things like this very, very easily.
cues.zh: 我自己花好幾個小時從頭研究撰寫，反而不太值得。

cues.en: So that is actually everything there is to it.
cues.zh: 整體來說，主要內容就是這些。

cues.en: There is some advanced JavaScript and HTML and CSS here, but the tool itself is just very, very simple tools
cues.zh: 這裡有一些比較進階的 JavaScript、HTML 與 CSS，但工具本身非常簡單，

cues.en: saying, hey, I have these two tools, Calculate and Open Calculator, and I have a resource that tells how to serve that HTML.
cues.zh: 只是提供 Calculate 與 OpenCalculator 兩個工具，再提供一個資源，告訴用戶端如何取得 HTML。

cues.en: The rest is just calls.
cues.zh: 剩下的就是各種呼叫。

cues.en: It could have called other things if need be, but in our case we keep it contained in the MCP so we don't need any credentials or anything.
cues.zh: 有需要也能呼叫其他服務，但這個例子把功能限制在 MCP 內部，因此不需要其他認證。

cues.en: So we can sit and actually do calculations on the fly here and get the context to the agent.
cues.zh: 所以可以直接在這裡進行即時計算，並把上下文提供給代理程式。

cues.en: This can be turned off if you don't want to do this all the time or you could have a small button set sent to AI, for example.
cues.zh: 如果不想每次都回傳上下文，也可以關閉，或加入一個「傳送給 AI」的小按鈕。

cues.en: So that is how MCP apps works.
cues.zh: 這就是 MCP Apps 的運作方式。

cues.en: It's actually kind of cool.
cues.zh: 其實相當酷。

cues.en: In real-life scenarios, I often talk about I integrate into Trello the Kanban tool,
cues.zh: 談到真實使用情境，我經常提到自己整合了 Trello 這個看板工具。

cues.en: and I have built MCP apps to show whenever I ask, hey, can you show me my live tasks,
cues.zh: 我也建立了 MCP App，當我要求顯示目前的任務時，

cues.en: it would actually make an MCP app with a list of my tasks where I can sit and click in and see details about them.
cues.zh: 它會顯示一個 MCP App，列出任務，讓我直接點選並查看細節。

cues.en: I can mark them as done.
cues.zh: 也能把任務標記為完成。

cues.en: I can move them around in the Kanban directly inside my chat here.
cues.zh: 還能直接在對話中，移動看板上的任務。

cues.en: So it's only really your imagination that stops you from what this can do in that advanced visualizations.
cues.zh: 因此這種進階視覺化能做到什麼，真正的限制只有你的想像力。

cues.en: It could be 3D models.
cues.zh: 例如可以是 3D 模型，

cues.en: It could be whatever that needs a better… where GUI is better at visualizing whatever that piece of content is.
cues.zh: 或是任何適合用圖形介面來呈現、比純文字更容易理解的內容。

cues.en: The way it works if something like this doesn't have the capability of MCP app is it will just get the metadata and then it will work from that by itself,
cues.zh: 如果某個用戶端不支援 MCP Apps，它仍然會取得中繼資料，並自行根據資料處理，

cues.en: but it won't be able to show the real visualizations.
cues.zh: 只是不會顯示真正的視覺化介面。

cues.en: So it is kind of backward-compatible in that way.
cues.zh: 因此在這方面具有一定的向下相容性。

cues.en: But that's everything there is to it. Go have a look.
cues.zh: 以上就是主要內容，歡迎實際看看。

cues.en: If you are JavaScript buff, you can go in and check out all the different parts of the spec, but essentially it's just sending things back and forward
cues.zh: 如果你很熟悉 JavaScript，可以進一步研究規格的各個部分。但基本上，就是在伺服器與沙箱 HTML 之間，

cues.en: between the server and a sandboxed HTML. We're done.
cues.zh: 來回傳送資料與訊息，這樣就完成了。

cues.en: Thank you and see you in the next one.
cues.zh: 感謝觀看，下一支影片見。
